sources.title: Deepfake Detection that Generalizes Across Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Recent efforts in detecting general AI-generated content [UniFD, CLIPping, SSL-in-DF, FatFormer] and facial deepfakes specifically [UDD, LipFD, DFD-FCG, ForensicsAdapter, Effort] have begun to adopt CLIP as a backbone for generalizable deepfake detection. These approaches can be broadly categorized by the type of model adaptation.
